## MSE

### MSE scaling using mean for scHiCluster and Higashi

```{r}
scale_sc_mat <- function(M, Theta, method = c("zisc","mean"), eps = 1e-12) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  stopifnot(ncol(M) == ncol(Theta))   # same number of cells
  K <- ncol(M)

  if (method == "zisc") {
    # zero-intercept scaling: least-squares
    num <- colSums(Theta * M)
    den <- colSums(M^2) + eps
    beta <- num / den
  } else if (method == "mean") {
    # mean-scaling: preserve total contacts per cell
    num <- colSums(Theta)
    den <- colSums(M) + eps
    beta <- num / den
  }

  scaled <- sweep(M, 2, beta, `*`)
  pmax(scaled, 0)
}

# --- scale scHiCluster matrices for all chromosomes ---
sc_scaled_all <- all_models_unified %>%
  filter(model %in% c("scHiCluster", "Higashi")) %>%
  mutate(
    muS = map2(muS, chr, ~ {
      Theta <- true_by_chr[[as.character(.y)]]
      scale_sc_mat(.x, Theta, method = "mean")
    })
  ) %>%
  mutate(model = paste0(model, "(scaled)"))

muS_unified_MSE = bind_rows(muS_unified, sc_scaled_all) %>% filter(!(model %in%  c("scHiCluster", "Higashi")))
```


### Calculating MSE

```{r}
get_SMRE <- function(truth, pred) {
  MSE <- mean((pred - truth)^2)
  var_truth <- stats::var(truth)
  MSE / var_truth
}
# Containers
MSE_row_list     <- vector("list", nrow(muS_unified_MSE))
MSE_overall_list <- vector("list", nrow(muS_unified_MSE))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(muS_unified_MSE))) {
  row_i   <- muS_unified_MSE[i, ]
  model_i <- as.character(row_i$model)
  chr_i   <- as.character(row_i$chr)
  cov_i   <- as.character(row_i$coverage)
  mu_i    <- row_i$muS[[1]]                # N × K
  trueM   <- true_by_chr[[chr_i]]          # N × K

  if (is.null(trueM)) next

  # --- Row-wise SMSE across cells ---
  # MSE_row(i) = mean_k (mu(i,k)-true(i,k))^2
  # SMSE_row(i) = MSE_row(i) / var_k(true(i,k))
  diff2          <- (mu_i - trueM)^2                 # N×K
  mse_row        <- rowMeans(diff2)                  # length N
  var_truth_row  <- apply(trueM, 1, stats::var)      # length N
  smse_row       <- mse_row / pmax(var_truth_row, 1e-12)

  MSE_row_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    model    = model_i,
    chr      = as.integer(chr_i),
    coverage = cov_i,
    pair_id  = seq_len(nrow(mu_i)),
    SMSE     = smse_row
  )

  # --- Overall SMSE (flatten) ---
  SMSE_overall <- get_SMRE(as.vector(trueM), as.vector(mu_i))
  MSE_overall_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    model    = model_i,
    chr      = as.integer(chr_i),
    coverage = cov_i,
    SMSE_overall = SMSE_overall
  )
}

MSE_row_df <- bind_rows(MSE_row_list) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = factor(coverage, levels = lambda_list),
    chr = as.integer(chr),
    model = factor(model)
  )

MSE_overall_df <- bind_rows(MSE_overall_list) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = factor(coverage, levels = lambda_list),
    chr = as.integer(chr)
  ) 

if (exists("region_info")) {
  MSE_row_df     <- MSE_row_df     %>% left_join(region_info %>% select(chr, facet_label), by = "chr")
  MSE_overall_df <- MSE_overall_df %>% left_join(region_info %>% select(chr, facet_label), by = "chr")
  facet_var <- "facet_label"
} else {
  facet_var <- "chr"
}

MSE_row_df$model = factor(MSE_row_df$model, levels = unique(MSE_row_df$model))
MSE_overall_df$model = factor(MSE_overall_df$model, levels = unique(MSE_overall_df$model))
```

## SCC

```{r}
scc_all <- all_models_unified %>%
  # filter(chr == "1", coverage == "0.03", model == "Simulated (Raw)") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    trueM = list(true_by_chr[[as.character(chr)]]),
    SCC   = list(map_dbl(seq_len(K), function(k) {
      out <- evaluate_mu(trueM[, k], muS[, k], smooth = 0)[5]
      # handle either numeric or list outputs
      if (is.numeric(out) && length(out) == 1) out else out[["SCC"]]
    })),
    method = model
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(chr, coverage, SCC, method) %>%
  unnest_longer(SCC, indices_to = "cell") %>% 
  left_join(region_info %>% select(chr, facet_label), by = "chr")
```

## IS



```{r, warning=F}
IS_list <- vector("list", nrow(all_models_unified))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(all_models_unified))) {
  row_i  <- all_models_unified[i, ]
  model_i <- as.character(row_i$model)
  chr_i   <- as.character(row_i$chr)
  cov_i   <- as.character(row_i$coverage)
  mu_i    <- row_i$muS[[1]]

  trueM <- true_by_chr[[chr_i]]
  if (is.null(trueM)) next

  IS_vec <- tryCatch(
    get_IS_cor(trueM, mu_i, n_cell = ncol(mu_i), win_size = 5, resolution = resolution),
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, ncol(mu_i))
  )
  IS_vec[is.na(IS_vec)] <- 0

  IS_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    model    = model_i,
    chr      = as.numeric(chr_i),
    coverage = cov_i,
    cell     = seq_len(ncol(mu_i)),
    IS       = as.numeric(IS_vec),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

IS_df <- bind_rows(IS_list) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = factor(coverage, levels = lambda_list),
    model    = factor(model, levels = unique(all_models_unified$model))
  ) %>%
  left_join(region_info %>% select(chr, facet_label), by = "chr")

```

## IS View


```{r}
winsize = 5 

get_IS_vec <- function(mu_long, winsize, resolution) {
  mu_long %>%
    matrix_long_to_matrix2D_offdiag() %>%
    calculate_insulation_score(
      window_size = winsize,
      bin_size = resolution
    )
}

IS_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(all_models_unified)), function(i){
  # i = 1
  mu_mat <- all_models_unified$muS[[i]]   # [N_pairs x K]
  K_row  <- ncol(mu_mat)

  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(K_row), function(k){
    # k = 1
    df_k <- get_IS_vec(mu_mat[, k], winsize, resolution)  # tibble/data.frame
    df_k$cell     <- k
    df_k$model    <- all_models_unified$model[i]
    df_k$chr      <- all_models_unified$chr[i]
    df_k$coverage <- all_models_unified$coverage[i]
    df_k
  }))

}))
```

```{r}
IS_long <- IS_long %>%
  mutate(
    model  = factor(model, levels = final_levels),
    chr = as.numeric(chr),
    coverage = factor(as.character(coverage), levels = lambda_list, ordered = TRUE),
  )
```


```{r}
IS_true <- bind_rows(lapply(chr_vec, function(chr_id) {
  trueM <- true_by_chr[[as.character(chr_id)]]  # [N_pairs x K]
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(K), function(cell_id) {
    get_IS_vec(trueM[, cell_id], winsize, resolution) %>%
      mutate(
        cell = cell_id,
        model = "Truth",
        chr = chr_id
      )

  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    chr = as.numeric(chr),
    coverage = NA  # keep column for compatibility with other IS tables
  )
```

### chr1 cell1 lambda0.5

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=5, warning=F}
cell_id <- 1
chr_id <- 1
coverage_id <- 0.5

IS_all <- bind_rows(
  IS_true %>% filter(cell == cell_id, chr == chr_id),
  IS_long %>% filter(cell == cell_id, chr == chr_id, coverage == coverage_id)
) %>%
  select(bin_index, IS_prime, model)

y_lim <- range(
  IS_all$IS_prime,
  finite = TRUE
)

method_colors <- c(
  "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "HiCBZIP-N(GS)"  = "#D55E00",  # orange
  "HiCBZIP-N(M)"   = "#CC79A7",  # magenta
  "HiCImpute"      = "#56B4E9",  # light blue
  "scHiCluster"    = "#E69F00",   # gold
  "Higashi"    = "purple"   # gold
)

base_colors <- c(
  "Truth" = "#009E73",          # green
  "Simulated (Raw)" = "grey65"
)

all_colors <- c(base_colors, method_colors)

ggplot(
  IS_all %>%
    mutate(
      model = trimws(as.character(model)),
      linetype = if_else(model == "Truth", "solid", "dashed")
    ),
  aes(x = bin_index, y = IS_prime, color = model, linetype = linetype)
) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = all_colors) +
  scale_linetype_identity() +          # ✅ THIS fixes the dashing
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim) +
  guides(linetype = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

for (method in final_levels[-1]) {

  IS_plot <- IS_all %>%
    filter(model %in% c("Truth", "Simulated (Raw)", method))

p = ggplot(
  IS_plot %>%
    mutate(
      model = trimws(as.character(model)),
      linetype = if_else(model == "Truth", "solid", "dashed")
    ),
  aes(x = bin_index, y = IS_prime, color = model, linetype = linetype)
) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = all_colors) +
  scale_linetype_identity() +          # ✅ THIS fixes the dashing
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim) +
  guides(linetype = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

  print(p)
}
```

### SMSE of lambda

```{r}
winsize <- 5
K <- 30

mse_IS <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(all_models_unified)), function(i){

  chr_i <- all_models_unified$chr[i]
  cov_i <- all_models_unified$coverage[i]
  mod_i <- all_models_unified$model[i]

  mu_i   <- all_models_unified$muS[[i]]                 # [N_pairs x K]
  trueM  <- true_by_chr[[as.character(chr_i)]]   # [N_pairs x K]

  mse_mat <- get_IS_mse(trueM, mu_i, n_cell = K,
                        win_size = winsize, resolution = resolution)

  data.frame(
    chr = chr_i,
    coverage = cov_i,
    cell = seq_len(K),
    model = mod_i,
    MSE = mse_mat[, "MSE"],
    sMSE = mse_mat[, "sMSE"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# make coverage ordered like before (optional)
mse_IS <- mse_IS %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = factor(as.character(coverage), levels = cov_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    chr = as.numeric(chr),
    model  = factor(model, levels = final_levels)
  )
mse_IS     <- mse_IS     %>% left_join(region_info %>% select(chr, facet_label), by = "chr")
```

## Clustering

### UMAP Example

```{r}
cell_type_label = true_by_chr$`1` %>% colnames() %>% substr(., 1, 10)
table(all_models_unified$model)
```

```{r, fig.width=12}
library(umap)
library(mclust)
## optional: ensure consistent model order
model_levels <- final_levels
plot_umap_chr1_by_coverage <- function(all_models_unified,
                                       chr_id = 1,
                                       n_neighbors = 10,
                                       n_rep = 10) {

  # subset to chosen chromosome
  chr_dat <- all_models_unified %>%
    filter(chr == chr_id)

  # coverage levels in desired order
  cov_levels <- levels(chr_dat$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(chr_dat$coverage))
  }

  for (covg in cov_levels) {
    dat_cov <- chr_dat %>%
      filter(coverage == covg) %>%
      mutate(
        model = factor(model,
                       levels = final_levels)
      ) %>%
      arrange(model)

    # list of matrices for this coverage
    list_muS_cov <- setNames(dat_cov$muS, as.character(dat_cov$model))

    set.seed(12345)
    umap_plots <- lapply(seq_along(list_muS_cov), function(i) {
      mat <- list_muS_cov[[i]]        # N x K
      model_name <- names(list_muS_cov)[i]

      # 1) all-zero or constant case → placeholder panel
      if (all(mat == 0) || stats::sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
        ggplot() +
          geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10, ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                    fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
          annotate("text",
                   x = 0, y = 0,
                   label = "(all imputed values = 0;\nUMAP / ARI not computed)",
                   size = 4) +
          xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = "ARI: NA"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      } else {
        # 2) normal case: run UMAP + k-means + ARI
        umap_cfg <- umap.defaults
        umap_cfg$n_neighbors   <- n_neighbors
        umap_cfg$random_state  <- 123456

        umap_res <- umap(t(mat), config = umap_cfg)
        emb <- as.data.frame(umap_res$layout)
        colnames(emb) <- c("X1", "X2")

        km_res <- kmeans(emb, centers = 3, nstart = n_rep)

        ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(
          km_res$cluster,
          rep(1:3, each = n_rep)
        )

        emb_df <- data.frame(
          X1      = emb$X1,
          X2      = emb$X2,
          Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
          Type    = cell_type_label   # length 30
        )

        ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                           color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
          geom_point(size = 1) +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      }
    })

    # 2 x 3 grid for this coverage
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(umap_plots,
        ncol = 4,
        top  = paste0("chr", chr_id, ", coverage λ = ", covg, " (UMAP)"))
    )
  }
}
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
plot_umap_chr1_by_coverage(all_models_unified, chr_id = 4, n_neighbors = n_rep,n_rep = n_rep)
```

### Get ARI



```{r}
set.seed(12345)
library(umap)
library(mclust)

ari_value <- lapply(1:length(all_models_unified$muS), function(i) {
  umap_results <- umap(t(all_models_unified$muS[[i]]), n_neighbors = n_rep, random_state=12345)
  embedding <- umap_results$layout
  kmeans_results <- kmeans(embedding, centers = 3, nstart = n_rep)
  embedding_df <- data.frame(embedding, Cluster = factor(kmeans_results$cluster), Type = cell_type_label)
  ari <- adjustedRandIndex(kmeans_results$cluster, rep(1:3, each = n_rep))
  return(ari)
})
```
